That night he wrote his own note, corked it tight, and let the tide decide where his few quiet words might someday wash ashore.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一个还没醒来的人，呼吸缓慢而均匀。路灯把空旷的街道照得发白，偶尔有一辆出租车驶过，水花溅起又落下。早点铺的卷帘门刚刚升起，蒸汽从锅里涌出来，混着豆浆的香气。清洁工推着车，扫帚划过地面发出沙沙的声响。天边泛起一层淡青色，高楼的轮廓渐渐清晰。这座城市在沉默里积蓄力量，等待第一缕阳光把它彻底唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n- Imagine standing in a line and asking the person ahead of you how many people are in front, until someone at the very front says zero.\n- Each person adds one to the answer passed back, so the whole line gets counted step by step."}
